primary.title: Summa Theologica
primary.author: Thomas Aquinas
primary.rationale: Aquinas's magnum opus, a comprehensive systematic theological work. It is a foundational text for Catholic theology and philosophy.

primary.title: Summa Contra Gentiles
primary.author: Thomas Aquinas
primary.rationale: A philosophical work intended to argue for the truth of Christianity against non-believers, particularly Muslims and Jews. It is a key text for understanding Aquinas's philosophical method.

primary.title: Commentary on Aristotle's Nicomachean Ethics
primary.author: Thomas Aquinas
primary.rationale: Aquinas's extensive commentary on Aristotle's foundational work of ethics, demonstrating his deep engagement with classical philosophy and its integration into Christian thought.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Aquinas
secondary.author: Norman Kretzmann
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Aquinas's thought, including his metaphysics, ethics, theology, and political philosophy. Published by a major academic press.

secondary.title: Aquinas: A Very Short Introduction
secondary.author: Edward Feser
secondary.rationale: A concise and accessible overview of Aquinas's life and major philosophical and theological ideas, suitable for introductory research. Part of a well-regarded academic series.

secondary.title: Thomas Aquinas and the Natural Law Tradition
secondary.author: John Finnis
secondary.rationale: An influential work by a prominent legal philosopher, exploring Aquinas's contribution to natural law theory and its contemporary relevance. Published by a major academic press.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are often available in multiple translations and editions. The years provided are approximate dates of completion for the works.
